name: x-llm-gateway
description: Modern LLM Gateway with protocol conversion, smart routing, and high availability

scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run build:web
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter './apps/*' typecheck && bun run --filter './packages/*' typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter './apps/*' lint && bun run --filter './packages/*' lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/.turbo packages/*/.turbo
